name: Greedy Brick Request Strategy
definition: A strategy where a ray requests intermediate levels of detail (bricks) along its path when a resolution is missing, flooding the hash table with requests. This produces more responsive, iteratively-refined images and converges in fewer frames.
summary: The Greedy Brick Request Strategy requests all intermediate levels of detail along a ray's path to prioritize iterative visual refinement and faster convergence over minimizing total brick requests.
